items.source: Variant of withPublisher(String, Publisher, Class) that accepts a ParameterizedTypeReference for the element type, which allows specifying generic type information.
items.translation: `withPublisher(String, Publisher, Class)` 的变体，接受一个 `ParameterizedTypeReference` 作为元素类型，从而允许指定泛型类型信息。

items.source: Add an asynchronous part with Publisher-based content.
items.translation: 添加一个异步部分，包含基于 `Publisher` 的内容。

items.source: typeReference - the type of elements contained in publisher
publisher - the publisher to be added as value
items.translation: publisher - 要作为值添加的发布者

items.source: this inserter for adding more parts
items.translation: 此插入器用于添加更多部件。

items.source: Extension of BodyInserters.FormInserter that allows for adding asynchronous parts.
items.translation: 扩展了BodyInserters.FormInserter，允许添加异步部分。

items.source: name - the name of the part to add
elementClass - the type of elements contained in the publisher
items.translation: elementClass - 发布器中包含的元素类型

items.source: Arjen Poutsma, Rossen Stoyanchev, Sebastien Deleuze
items.translation: Arjen Poutsma, Rossen Stoyanchev, Sebastien Deleuze
